$Comment: The Hallowed set: the Jack Helm worn and the Jack Shield in the utility slot. Its one tier asks for exactly that, Armor 1 and Utility 1, so a shield carried in the main hand never counts. While it holds, the tier adds Health and puts on the set's effect, Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Set, which carries the glow and the fire ward. Raise or lower the Amount to tune the set; under Parent the Bonuses list replaces whole, so restate the tier you keep. The text keys live in hallowseve.items.lang.
